name: Mezza Luna
reviewNotes:
Added for its own event calendar in src/content/sources (PR #8). The dance floor has not been researched yet.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Address, phone, email and hours confirmed on the restaurant's own contact page; address and phone match Google Maps. Hauppauge is in Suffolk County. Hours combine the contact page's table: Sat 5 PM (dining) with the bar opening at 12 PM on Saturday and Sunday. Live music is one performer at dinner on Fridays; the site does not mention a dance floor (the party rooms may have space for dancing at private events, not confirmed). Photo 2 is from the private-events page (a bar in one of the party rooms). The logo is white on a transparent background, so it needs a dark backdrop.
hours: Mon-Thu 12 PM-9 PM; Fri 12 PM-10 PM; Sat 5 PM-10 PM; Sun 3 PM-9 PM (bar opens 12 PM Sat-Sun)
description: An Italian fine-dining restaurant on Vanderbilt Motor Parkway in Hauppauge, with a bar and rooms for private parties. A solo singer or musician plays live music on Friday evenings from 6 to 9 PM.

logo.alt: Mezza Luna Fine Italian logo: the name in white capital letters beside a crescent moon, with 'Est. 2022' above (white on a transparent background)

evidence.note: Restaurant's contact page gives 644 Vanderbilt Motor Pkwy, Hauppauge, NY 11788, phone (631) 273-9407, info@mezzalunafinedining.com and weekly hours.
Events page lists live music with a solo performer most Fridays, 6 to 9 PM, into November 2026.
Google Maps lists Mezza Luna (Italian restaurant) at the same address and phone, website mezzalunafinedining.com; Sunday hours 3 to 9 PM match the site.
